name: RMIT Study Support Scholarship
summary: $3,000 for one year, paid fortnightly, for RMIT students whose circumstances affect their study.
key: $3,000 for one year full-time, or $1,500 part-time.
who: Australian or NZ citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder.
Enrolling in Semester 1 2027 in an eligible RMIT program.
Circumstances that affect your study, or from an RMIT priority group.
how: Apply direct to RMIT online (preferred) or through VTAC, with supporting documents.

evidence.quote: This scholarship provides $3,000 for one year for full-time enrolled students.
Applications for Semester 1 2027 close 2:00pm Tuesday 20 October 2026.
